$comment: The theme's colour decisions (contract colour-config/1, docs/foundation.md#colour-model). tools/colour.mjs generates tokens.colour.json from this file; never edit that file by hand. Pins hold v0's hand-tuned colours so the default theme did not restyle; unpinned steps follow the pinned tone curve.

brand.$comment: Up to four brand colours in numbered slots 1-4 (owner, F7d: numbered, not primary/secondary/tertiary). At least one slot is defined; any other may be left undefined. accent names the slot that actions, links, focus and selection read; 1 by default.

base.$comment: Base colours: black, white and the greys between. The model's default temperature is neutral; this library's own theme is cool because v0's hand-tuned greys measure cool (OKLCH hue 286, chroma up to 0.019), pinned so nothing restyled.

sets.name: category
sets.purpose: Category identity in data and labels: chart series, category badges, shares of a whole. Read through color.category.1-8 only. Never status (use color.status.*), never an action, focus or selection colour, never the only cue (words or a legend always name the category).

sets.name: ai
sets.purpose: The AI processing state only (Q56): gradient stops for the ring of a prompt box or composer while a model works, and the aurora field of an image being generated (Q58), read through color.ai.1-4. Never status (use color.status.*), never focus, selection or an action colour, never the only cue (words and an announcement always say it's working).

sets.name: pastel
sets.purpose: Soft fills behind illustrations and empty-state art. Never text, never status, never a control.
